title: Ari learns a name
summary: The vocabulary comes from memory, with phrases from real use. You undo two corrections the phone made; the mishearing of a name joins that person's page, and a word no page names becomes a term of its own.

pages.title: Bora
pages.markdown: Bora chairs the QRT panel at work, and you run with her on Saturdays (as of 20 Oct).

pages.title: QRT panel
pages.markdown: The QRT panel reviews your design in November; Bora wants one more round first (as of 22 Oct).
